page.overview:
Who is Ara?

Ara was born into the Fifth Nation, and her early life was difficult due to her pirate parents being neglectful. After coming of age, she joined the ranks of the pirate nation, but she always felt uncomfortable unlike her parents who relished their criminal lifestyle. After the Fall of the Fifth Nation in 296 BG, Ara took the opportunity to abandon the remnants of the pirate coalition. As a refugee, she migrated to the small state of Jasmine Island, where she embraced the local culture and people. Resolving to build a new life for herself in accordance with her true wishes, she joined the local security forces, the "protectors".

Ara's new life truly started when she took part in a formal tea ceremony in an temple at Jasmine Island's coast, where she and four others —Joh, Fu Karaq, Revik, Yarru— had gathered with the protectors' leader Chidaw and an elderly talekeeper named Siarruk. In this ceremony, they officially joined the protectors. Later that day, the five new protectors opted to celebrate their new status together, and took a small fishing boat on a joyride. Eventually, they spotted a large warship approaching Jasmine Island, followed by a smaller vessel. To the group's shock, the large ship was manned by Fifth Nation corsairs under Tagaka, while the smaller ship was attacking them under the leadership of famous Fire National Hei-Ran. After making contact with the latter, Ara and her comrades hurried back to Jasmine Island to warn the locals of the upcoming pirate raid.

The group and the other protectors subsequently fended off a first landing led by a pirate scout force under Erchtei. Indeed, Ara and her comrades fought hard in the subsequent battle, even battling Tagaka herself and helping to defeat Erchtei, though both managed to escape. The group also discovered that another protector, Mirlon, had defected to the Fifth Nation and assisted the raid. They confronted the turncoat.

Ara and her comrades subsequently helped to decide what the Jasmine Islanders should do with the pirates captured during the failed raid. They also tried to mediate in an unexpected dispute between Hei-Ran and the rescued Tei Eesoni.
